name: Augustus
notes_this_chapter: ch1 [event] Lonesome Dove: Hot, dusty border town in the chaparral where the Hat Creek Cattle Company keeps its house, lots and the Dry Bean saloon nearby.
ch1 [event] Hat Creek: Nearly always-dry sandy creek by the outfit's wagon yard; a storm once washed the barn roof down it into the Rio Grande.
ch1 [event] Rio Grande: Border river beside the town; the outfit crosses it at night to raid Mexican stock, and cattle get chased back and forth across it.
ch1 [mention] Mexico: Lies across the river; Call bought his biting mare there, and the partners ride in to steal horses and cattle.
ch1 [mention] Pickles Gap: Tiny settlement founded by a lost Georgian; Call claims it has good shade, Augustus scorns it as even worse than Lonesome Dove.
ch1 [mention] Tennessee: Augustus, like the barber Dillard Brawley, is a Tennessean; whiskey makes him feel like a cool Tennessee morning.
ch1 [mention] Texas: Augustus thinks himself the only man in south Texas who can keep Call in proportion.
ch1 [mention] Prairie Dog Town Fork Red River: Where Comanches trapped Call, Augustus and six Rangers in dug holes; Augustus argued about coon dogs all night before they slipped away.
ch1 [mention] Scotland: Augustus reminds Call he was born there and brought over as a baby.
ch1 [end of chapter] with Call, Pea Eye, Newt, Bolivar at Lonesome Dove: at the Hat Creek Cattle Company house in town

name: Pea Eye
notes_this_chapter: ch1 [event] Lonesome Dove: Hot, dusty border town in the chaparral where the Hat Creek Cattle Company keeps its house, lots and the Dry Bean saloon nearby.
ch1 [mention] Brazos River: After Indians took their horses, the Rangers walked nearly two hundred miles down it, fearing Comanches.
ch1 [mention] Stone House: Site of a smoky Ranger battle with the Keechis where Pea Eye lost hearing in one ear and the horses were stolen.
ch1 [end of chapter] with Augustus, Call, Newt, Bolivar at Lonesome Dove: at the Hat Creek Cattle Company house in town

name: Lorena
notes_this_chapter: ch2 [event] Lonesome Dove: Evening on the outfit's porch; piano music drifts from the Dry Bean saloon, where Lorena lives upstairs.

name: Lippy
notes_this_chapter: ch3 [event] Lonesome Dove: Lorena lives above the Dry Bean saloon, cooking at first and then taking customers; Augustus offers her money just to talk.
ch3 [mention] Mexico: Lippy says Lorena could get rich working there, but she finds it no more appealing than Texas.

name: Xavier Wanz
notes_this_chapter: ch3 [event] Lonesome Dove: Lorena lives above the Dry Bean saloon, cooking at first and then taking customers; Augustus offers her money just to talk.

name: Dish Boggett
notes_this_chapter: ch4 [event] Lonesome Dove: Augustus walks past the Pumphreys' store to the Dry Bean, plays cards late, and lends Dish two dollars before the cowboy heads up to Lorena.
ch4 [mention] New Orleans: Xavier's birthplace, where he once worked in a restaurant with tablecloths; Shanghai Pierce goes there to take the train north.
ch4 [mention] Matamoros: Dish delivered horses there and lost a month's pay gambling before riding about a hundred miles upriver.
ch4 [mention] Abilene: Trail town where Dish imagines buying Lorena a present.
ch4 [mention] Dodge City: Dish usually brings back ribbons and combs from there for Mexican girls.
ch4 [end of chapter] with Lorena, Lippy, Xavier Wanz at Lonesome Dove: at the Dry Bean saloon; Dish upstairs with Lorena, about to leave with a trail outfit next week

name: Deets
notes_this_chapter: ch5 [event] Lonesome Dove: Augustus bakes biscuits at sunrise; over breakfast Call floats a trail drive and offers Dish work, then spots Deets riding in with Jake Spoon.
ch5 [mention] San Antonio: Deets was sent there three days earlier to deposit money; the stage road north from town leads to it.
ch5 [end of chapter] with Jake Spoon at Lonesome Dove: riding in along the stage road from San Antonio, just north of town

name: Jake Spoon
notes_this_chapter: ch5 [event] Lonesome Dove: Augustus bakes biscuits at sunrise; over breakfast Call floats a trail drive and offers Dish work, then spots Deets riding in with Jake Spoon.
ch5 [end of chapter] with Deets at Lonesome Dove: riding in along the stage road from San Antonio, just north of town

name: July Johnson
notes_this_chapter: ch6 [mention] Fort Smith: Under three weeks ago Jake's stray buffalo-rifle shot killed the town's dentist-mayor, brother of Sheriff July Johnson; Jake fled.
ch6 [mention] Missouri: Sheriff July Johnson was away there testifying against stage robbers when the shooting happened.

name: Chick
notes_this_chapter: ch8 [event] Lonesome Dove: Wilbarger rides in seeking horses past Augustus's elaborate livery sign; Dish finds Lorena now taken with Jake at the Dry Bean and drinks heavily.
ch8 [mention] Sabinas: Dish falsely tells Chick the brothel is there, across the river, to keep him away from Lorena.
ch8 [end of chapter] with Wilbarger at Lonesome Dove: at the Hat Creek house asking to buy horses; their herd waits beyond the Nueces

name: Wilbarger
notes_this_chapter: ch8 [event] Lonesome Dove: Wilbarger rides in seeking horses past Augustus's elaborate livery sign; Dish finds Lorena now taken with Jake at the Dry Bean and drinks heavily.
ch8 [mention] Nueces River: Wilbarger has a herd gathered beyond it but lost most of his horses to Mexican raiders.
ch8 [mention] Kansas: Destination of Wilbarger's cattle drive.
ch8 [end of chapter] with Chick at Lonesome Dove: at the Hat Creek house asking to buy horses; their herd waits beyond the Nueces

name: Sean O'Brien
notes_this_chapter: ch10 [event] Flores wranglers' burnt-out camp: In a roofless hut by a broken corral, Call, Deets and Newt find two lost, hungry Irish brothers and promise to send horses back for them.
ch10 [mention] Ireland: The O'Brien brothers are Irish and miss their potatoes.
ch10 [end of chapter] with Allen O'Brien at Flores wranglers' burnt-out camp: waiting with a hobbled mule and a donkey for horses to be sent back

name: Allen O'Brien
notes_this_chapter: ch10 [event] Flores wranglers' burnt-out camp: In a roofless hut by a broken corral, Call, Deets and Newt find two lost, hungry Irish brothers and promise to send horses back for them.

ch10 [mention] Galveston: The Irishmen's intended destination; Call says they badly overshot it.

name: Jasper Fant
notes_this_chapter: ch13 [event] Lonesome Dove: At the Dry Bean saloon Jake charms Lorena, bathes in her room upstairs and wins her; afterward she stops taking customers.
ch13 [mention] Rio Grande: Cowboys working along it, including Jasper Fant, hear that Lorena has quit her trade.

name: Pete Spettle
notes_this_chapter: ch16 [event] Spettle farm: Call hires the two oldest boys of a poor widow's barefoot family; they set off on foot for Lonesome Dove.
ch16 [end of chapter] with Bill Spettle at Brush Country: walking from their farm north of Pickles Gap toward Lonesome Dove

name: Jimmy Rainey
notes_this_chapter: ch16 [event] Rainey ranch: Call eats a huge supper, sleeps in a wagon in the yard, and gets two Rainey sons promised for the drive.
ch16 [end of chapter] with Maude Rainey, Joe Rainey, Ben Rainey at Rainey ranch: Jimmy and Ben promised to reach Lonesome Dove by week's end

name: Needle Nelson
notes_this_chapter: ch17 [event] Lonesome Dove: Jake lives with Lorena above the Dry Bean while new hands play cards there; on a hot day Augustus wins a cut of cards and buys Lorena's favors.
ch17 [mention] San Antonio: Needle Nelson comes from north of it; Lorena considers ordering new dresses from there.
ch17 [mention] Yellowstone River: Needle frets they'll cross it on ice if they don't start soon; Jasper expects drownings before then.
ch17 [end of chapter] with Call, Jake Spoon, Dish Boggett, Jasper Fant, Bert Borum at Hat Creek cow camp: gathering and branding cattle near Lonesome Dove ahead of the drive

ch17 [mention] Brownsville: Hometown of the cheerful new hand Bert Borum.
ch17 [end of chapter] with Call, Jake Spoon, Dish Boggett, Jasper Fant, Needle Nelson at Hat Creek cow camp: gathering and branding cattle near Lonesome Dove ahead of the drive

name: Soupy Jones
notes_this_chapter: ch23 [event] Hat Creek herd camp near Lonesome Dove: At dawn Soupy Jones arrives and is hired; Gus's pigs turn up; Augustus hitches the mule wagon while Call culls the remuda.
ch23 [mention] Bastrop: Soupy has just come from this small town, where his wife died.
ch23 [end of chapter] with Call, Pea Eye, Newt, Dish Boggett, Jasper Fant, Bolivar at Hat Creek herd camp near Lonesome Dove: preparing to start the herd north

name: Peach
notes_this_chapter: ch26 [event] Fort Smith: Jaundiced Sheriff July and deputy Roscoe sit by the one-cell jail; widowed Peach presses July to pursue Jake Spoon for killing Ben, the mayor.
ch26 [mention] Mexico: Peach warns the killer will slip off there if July delays.
ch26 [end of chapter] with nobody at Fort Smith: heading home with her dead rooster

ch26 [mention] Arkansas River: Roscoe and Joe fish for catfish there; brawling rivermen are the sheriff's biggest headache.
ch26 [end of chapter] with Elmira at Fort Smith: at July's home in town

ch26 [mention] Missouri: July caught jaundice there at a trial; Elmira was once married there to Dee Boot.
ch26 [mention] Kansas: Elmira comes from there, so Fort Smith knows little of her past.
ch26 [end of chapter] with Joe at Fort Smith: at July's home in town

ch26 [mention] Arkansas River: Roscoe and Joe fish for catfish there; brawling rivermen are the sheriff's biggest headache.
ch26 [mention] San Antonio: July expects to find Jake around there among friends; Roscoe notes those friends are famous Texas Rangers.
ch26 [mention] Texas: Roscoe frets about July tangling with Jake's Texas Ranger friends.
ch26 [end of chapter] with July Johnson at Fort Smith: July heading home from the jail; Roscoe stays on the jail porch

name: Dee Boot
notes_this_chapter: ch27 [mention] Kansas: Elmira was stranded there young and knew Jake and Dee Boot there as friends.
ch27 [mention] Dodge City: Elmira worked there as a prostitute; Jake teased she'd turn respectable.
ch27 [mention] Abilene: Scene of Elmira's wild years with Dee, his prank pie on a madam, and a girl's grim death on icy stairs.
ch27 [mention] St. Joseph: Dee staked Elmira to a fresh start there; she met July watching the trial where he testified.

name: Fowler
notes_this_chapter: ch36 [event] Arkansas River: Elmira rides a whiskey traders' boat slowly upstream as it narrows into the plains; Big Zwey kills a trader in a fight over her and the body is dumped overboard.
ch36 [end of chapter] with Elmira, Big Zwey at Arkansas River: on a whiskey boat heading upriver from Fort Smith, now out on the plains

name: Big Zwey
notes_this_chapter: ch36 [event] Arkansas River: Elmira rides a whiskey traders' boat slowly upstream as it narrows into the plains; Big Zwey kills a trader in a fight over her and the body is dumped overboard.

name: Janey
notes_this_chapter: ch43 [event] Texas: Roscoe worried he'd never find it; once there he finds the settlers unfriendly and heads southwest.
ch43 [event] Old Sam's cabin: A surly old man takes Roscoe's whiskey, gives him no supper and beats the girl he bought for skunk hides during the night.
ch43 [event] Creek where Janey joins Roscoe: Runaway Janey packs mud on Roscoe's wasp stings, catches a rabbit and a frog for lunch, and rides on with him.
ch43 [mention] San Antonio: Soldiers tell Roscoe to hold southwest to reach it; Janey says she walked all the way from there.
ch43 [mention] Fort Worth: A man called Bill was taking Janey there before trading her away.
ch43 [mention] Waco: Near there Bill got drunk with old Sam and traded Janey to him.
ch43 [end of chapter] with Roscoe Brown at Creek where Janey joins Roscoe: riding double southwest toward San Antonio, a few miles past old Sam's cabin in north Texas

name: Blue Duck
notes_this_chapter: ch45 [event] Lorena's camp: Lorena waits here for Jake; Augustus swims in the cold water hole, Blue Duck rides in to water his horse, threatens, then leaves.
ch45 [mention] Canadian River: Blue Duck threatens to mutilate Augustus if he ever comes north of it.
ch45 [end of chapter] with nobody at Lorena's camp: rode off over a ridge from the pool; destination unknown

name: Po Campo
notes_this_chapter: ch47 [event] Hat Creek outfit's cow camp: The herd stampedes at night toward the bluffs; at dawn Pea finds Newt afoot and the new cook Po Campo walks in with his donkey.
ch47 [end of chapter] with Newt at Hat Creek outfit's cow camp: walking the last few hundred yards to the wagon

name: Ermoke
notes_this_chapter: ch49 [event] Red-sand river crossing: Wide riverbed of boggy reddish sand with a thin brown stream; Ermoke and three renegades wait on the far side.
ch49 [event] Grassland beyond the sand river: Past the river the party stops at sundown and Ermoke's men assault Lorena before riding on by moonlight.
ch49 [end of chapter] with Blue Duck, Lorena at Grassland beyond the sand river: a short ride past a broad red-sand river, several days from the herd, waiting for moonrise

name: Luke
notes_this_chapter: ch53 [event] Arkansas River: Elmira rides the whiskey boat upriver, sensing Big Zwey watching her, until the cargo is unloaded into wagons.
ch53 [event] Bent's Fort: A shabby, busy trading post reeking of buffalo hides; Elmira lodges in a flea-ridden closet and agrees to let Big Zwey take her to Ogallala.
ch53 [event] Plains north of Bent's Fort: Elmira drives a patched hide wagon while the men hunt buffalo; she nearly overturns at a steep creek and shelters under the wagon in a storm.
ch53 [end of chapter] with Elmira, Big Zwey at Plains north of Bent's Fort: a few days out from Bent's Fort by hide wagon, bound for Ogallala

name: Monkey John
notes_this_chapter: ch55 [event] Blue Duck's camp on the Canadian: Lorena is held and abused in a filthy camp near a creek; Blue Duck kills a young Kiowa while gambling and sends Ermoke to ambush Gus.
ch55 [event] Canadian River: The men complain they are stranded on it without horses; Blue Duck expects Gus to come down it.
ch55 [end of chapter] with Lorena, Dog Face at Blue Duck's camp on the Canadian: camp on the Canadian River plains near a creek

notes_this_chapter: ch55 [event] Blue Duck's camp on the Canadian: Lorena is held and abused in a filthy camp near a creek; Blue Duck kills a young Kiowa while gambling and sends Ermoke to ambush Gus.

name: Roy Suggs
notes_this_chapter: ch64 [event] Dallas: Jake hears the Arkansas sheriff is in Texas, meets the Suggs brothers' regulating and bank-robbing schemes, and rides north with them.
ch64 [end of chapter] with Jake Spoon, Dan Suggs, Eddie Suggs, Frog Lip at Dallas: riding north from Dallas toward Kansas, at least a day out

notes_this_chapter: ch64 [event] Dallas: Jake hears the Arkansas sheriff is in Texas, meets the Suggs brothers' regulating and bank-robbing schemes, and rides north with them.
ch64 [mention] Kansas: The Suggs plan to tax trail herds at its river crossings and rob its banks; Jake means to leave them at a Kansas saloon.
ch64 [end of chapter] with Jake Spoon, Roy Suggs, Eddie Suggs, Frog Lip at Dallas: riding north from Dallas toward Kansas, at least a day out

name: Sally
notes_this_chapter: ch75 [event] Clara's ranch: Clara's horse ranch with a frame house; Bob lies paralyzed there, and Elmira arrives exhausted, gives birth to a boy, then slips away leaving him.
ch75 [end of chapter] with Clara, Betsey, Cholo, Bob Allen at Clara's ranch: at the ranch house on the Platte, Clara caring for Bob and Elmira's newborn boy

name: Clara
notes_this_chapter: ch75 [event] Clara's ranch: Clara's horse ranch with a frame house; Bob lies paralyzed there, and Elmira arrives exhausted, gives birth to a boy, then slips away leaving him.
ch75 [event] North Platte River: Elmira's wagon arrives along it from the west; Clara once washed her hair in its icy water and watches mists over it.
ch75 [event] Nebraska: Elmira asks if they have reached it yet; Clara followed Bob to its hard plains years ago.
ch75 [mention] Ogallala: Rough town twenty miles off where Clara seldom goes; Jules plays piano there, Cholo shops there, and Elmira hopes to find Dee Boot.
ch75 [mention] Arkansas: Elmira says she has come all the way from there.
ch75 [mention] Texas: Clara's piano and house money came from selling her parents' business there; she was once its most courted girl.
ch75 [mention] St. Louis: Clara ordered her piano from there.
ch75 [mention] Red River of the North: Jules the piano player once traded there before smallpox ruined his business.
ch75 [mention] Missouri: Grandparents of neighbor Maude Jones's children came from there to fetch them.
ch75 [mention] Cincinnati: Clara has an aunt there she writes to once or twice a year.
ch75 [mention] Wyoming: Clara loves watching morning light spread across the plains toward it.
ch75 [mention] England: Clara orders magazines from there and the East.
ch75 [end of chapter] with Sally, Betsey, Cholo, Bob Allen at Clara's ranch: at the ranch house on the Platte, Clara caring for Bob and Elmira's newborn boy

ch75 [mention] Dismal River: Cholo survived an April blizzard there thanks to the buffalo coat Clara bought him.

name: Patrick Arandel
notes_this_chapter: ch80 [event] Ogallala: Elmira recovers at Dr. Arandel's house, learns Dee was hanged and buried on Boot Hill, rebuffs July's visit, then leaves with Zwey.

name: Old Hugh Auld
notes_this_chapter: ch95 [event] Montana: Augustus hobbles southeast across open prairie and collapses; old trapper Hugh Auld finds him, warns the leg must come off, and lends his horse.
ch95 [mention] Lonesome Dove: Augustus tells the trapper he hails from this small town on the Rio Grande.
ch95 [end of chapter] with nobody at Montana: on foot somewhere on the plains northwest of Miles City, following Augustus

name: Dr. Mobley
notes_this_chapter: ch96 [event] Miles City: In a small room across from a saloon where a sick girl plays piano, Augustus wakes one-legged, refuses a second amputation, gives Call his last wishes, and dies.
ch96 [mention] Philadelphia: The piano-playing saloon girl reportedly studied music there.
